summary: New Octavia Foundation shops/pricing matrix (8 criteria: 14-shop seed data, versioned pricing-rules with merge semantics, shop CRUD master-only, preview-adjustment math, inventory create ledger write, inventory PATCH re-pricing with custom-price override, SEC-001 body-size/length caps on /api/shops, and a mobile admin-UI browser smoke). Added 7 new backend pytest files (23 tests) and 2 new browser checks. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: master POST /api/shops always 500s (TypeError: Shop() got multiple values for keyword argument 'name' in routers/shops.py:55) - shop creation is completely broken.

checks.name: pytest tests/test_tscheck_shops_seeded_data.py
checks.evidence: 2 passed. GET /api/shops (master) -> 200, 14 rows; Askew Road W12 9BJ zone 2 'Shepherd's Bush Market'; Brompton Road SW3 2EJ zone 1; Tooting SW17 0RG zone 3; Chiswick High Road W4 1PA zone 2 needs_zone_review=true; Fulham Road SW10 9PZ zone 2 needs_zone_review=true; West Hampstead zone 2 (empty address OK); King's Road SW3 5EP zone 1; no 'Chiswick' old name; no other shop missing postcode. Volunteer (SarahTest) GET /api/shops -> 200, >=14 rows (skip-safe if login rate-limited).

checks.evidence: 3 passed. GET /shops/pricing-rules -> 200 with all 7 adjustment keys present (Z1=0.0 confirmed); unauthenticated PUT -> 401/403; master PUT {adjustments:{'3':-12}} -> version+1, Z1 unchanged at 0.0, Z3 merged to -12.0, subsequent GET reflects it; rollback PUT {'3':-10} -> version+2, Z3 restored to -10.0 (environment left at spec defaults).

checks.criterion: Shop CRUD is master-only and preserves data integrity
checks.name: pytest tests/test_tscheck_shop_crud_master_only.py
checks.evidence: Non-master POST/PATCH/DELETE on /api/shops/* correctly return 401 (passed). Master POST /api/shops with a unique name -> 500 Internal Server Error (expected 201). Server log: 'File "/app/backend/routers/shops.py", line 55, in create_shop: shop = Shop(**body.model_dump(), name=body.name.strip()) / TypeError: models.shop.Shop() got multiple values for keyword argument 'name'. Confirmed independently via raw curl (POST /api/shops as master -> 500 every time). Shop creation is completely broken; the rest of the criterion (duplicate-name 409, PATCH zone-clearing semantics, soft-disable) could not be exercised because no fixture shop can be created.

checks.name: admin-nonmaster-redirects-and-scan-dropdown

Signed out via More page (more-signout), then master signed in, captured a mock camera photo on /scan, ran Appraise, opened the appraisal-location-select dropdown and confirmed appraisal-location-Tooting is present -- Tooting is only in the DB-backed shops collection (no static fallback tuple entry), confirming useShopNames is live-wired. Re-ran persisted check: passed again (stable).

action_items: CRITICAL BUG (confirmed via pytest + raw curl + server log): POST /api/shops always returns 500 for the master role because routers/shops.py:55 does `Shop(**body.model_dump(), name=body.name.strip())` where body.model_dump() already contains a 'name' key, producing `TypeError: models.shop.Shop() got multiple values for keyword argument 'name'`. This blocks the entire 'Add shop' admin-UI flow and the master-POST-creates-a-shop acceptance criterion. Fix: drop the redundant name= kwarg, e.g. `Shop(**{**body.model_dump(), "name": body.name.strip()})` or exclude name from the dump before splatting.

Because shop creation 500s, the duplicate-name (409), PATCH zone-clearing (outside_zones/needs_zone_review interplay), and soft-disable/include_disabled parts of the shop-CRUD criterion could not be exercised end-to-end on a freshly created shop in this iteration; only the non-master-rejection half of that criterion is independently confirmed. Re-run tests/test_tscheck_shop_crud_master_only.py after the create-shop bug is fixed to get full coverage (the test file already contains those assertions, gated behind the successful POST).

Pre-existing, out of scope for this matrix (carried over from iteration 15): tests/test_tscheck_appraise_robustness_and_gating.py::test_appraise_returns_200_three_times_in_a_row and tests/test_tscheck_appraise_endpoint.py::test_appraise_with_real_image_returns_valid_appraisal fail because the fixture image at /tmp/item.jpg doesn't exist in this environment.
